analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.19) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.25/$1.28/$1.38): below short/mid-term trends, weak.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($1.31/$1.27): below long-term trends, weak.
· 52-week position (12.9%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.1→34.5): entering oversold, downside momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0036→-0.0034): improving but still negative, no confirmed reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $1.20): approaching lower band, oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.13): based on 52-week low and Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance ($1.26): based on SMA20 and Pivot PP, short-term bounce expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not formed, Lower High formed): sideways and weak pressure.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.62x 5-day average): surge, suggesting potential for a bounce.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold and volume surge indicate potential for a short-term bounce, but maintain a wait-and-see approach until recovery above SMA200.
